summary: Iter-29 frontend verification of the canvas-physics-authoritative rewrite. The HARD CRITICAL requirement — 'canvas-score at match end MUST equal match.result.home.score/away.score' — PASSES in every single match observed (6/6 group matchdays played end-to-end). PreMatch UI, canvas mounting, testid coverage, skip functionality, POTM rendering, tournament consistency all PASS. HOWEVER, three notable behavioural issues around log/commentary richness were reproduced consistently: (A) SHOT (off-target) events never fire in any of 6 full matches — pitchSim's ball-goes-past-goal-line-with-pendingShot branch appears to never trigger, so `Şut auta gitti` lines are 0 across every match. (B) Filler commentary never renders — despite CanvasMatch scheduling filler at every ~30-60 ticks based on `st.tick >= nextFillerRef.current && !st.kickoffTimer`, zero grey filler lines appeared in any of 6 x 30s runs. (C) Overall event density is very low: 6 matches produced GOAL=2 total (in MD4/MD5), SAVE=3 total (MD1 x2, MD3 x1), SHOT=0, FILLER=0. MD2 and MD6 had ZERO events in the entire 30s regulation, so canvas-minute never rendered (by design — MatchScreen only sets liveMinute when emittedRegEvents.length > 0). The review request 'Log richness: 20+ seconds shows GOAL amber, SAVE emerald, SHOT white, filler grey lines' cannot be met with current sim/renderer behaviour — most matches show 0-2 total lines. Determinism verified: for each match, canvas-score displayed at time of skip / natural end EQUALS the post-done scoreboard which reads from currentLeg.home.score/away.score (i.e. match.result). This holds for both 0-0 low-event matches (MD1,2,3,6) and 1-0 matches (MD4,5). Skip is very fast (25-55ms measured across 6 attempts) — comfortably under the 500ms target. Kickoff-phase skip also works (55ms) and lands on post-match with correct deterministic score + potm-card.

ui_bugs.issue: SHOT (off-target) events fire zero times across 6 full 30s matches. The code path at pitchSim.js:286-299 (ball.x < 0 || ball.x > PITCH_W with a pendingShotTick>-1) apparently never triggers — probably because saves at pitchSim.js:322-353 claim the ball first (near.dist<1.85) before it can cross the goal line off-target. Result: log never shows any 'Şut auta gitti' white lines.

Filler lines (FILLER_BUILDUP/ATTACK/KEEPER) never appear in the log across 6 full matches. The gate `st.tick >= nextFillerRef.current && !st.kickoffTimer` at CanvasMatch.tsx:252 evidently never resolves true — likely because state.kickoffTimer > 0 for the full replay (need to confirm pitchSim decrements/clears kickoffTimer). Result: log stays empty in low-event matches (MD2 and MD6 produced literally 0 log lines during 30s of play).

canvas-minute badge never appears in matches with 0 physics events (2 of 6 matches). By design `liveMinute` requires emittedRegEvents.length>0, so a truly dead match shows no clock. Combined with issues A/B, a 30s match can render literally just 'Maç başladı...' the entire time, which looks broken to users.

6 matches produced only 2 goals + 3 saves + 0 shots + 0 tackles = ~5 events total across ~3 minutes of physics. Standings show large clusters of 0-0 draws (Groups D, most of H). Physics is too passive for engaging gameplay — expected ~2-3 goals/match + shots + saves + occasional filler.

issues: Console warning about willReadFrequently is only triggered by test harness sampling — not user-facing. Same as iter-27/28.

action_items: Investigate why pitchSim's off-target SHOT branch (ball.x crosses 0 or PITCH_W with pendingShotTick > -1) never fires in practice. Either loosen the keeper-claim radius (pitchSim.js:322 `near.dist < 1.85`) or check whether ball speed carries it past the goal line in the same frame it enters the box.

Investigate why filler commentary never fires. Check if `state.kickoffTimer` in pitchSim is ever cleared to 0/false (search for `kickoffTimer` assignments). If it stays truthy for the whole match the CanvasMatch filler gate at CanvasMatch.tsx:252 is permanently blocked.

Consider showing canvas-minute even before the first event (e.g., derive minute from `stateRef.current.minute` inside CanvasMatch instead of only from emitted events). Otherwise dead matches (2 of 6 observed) show no clock for the entire 30s.

Consider increasing overall physics event density (bump attack/keeper strength scaling in pitchSim.createPitchState or reduce keeper reach) so matches average 2-3 goals + several shots + several saves instead of the current ~1 event/match.
The critical determinism invariant IS met — this is the CORE contract of iter-29 and it is solid. Above items are polish for the observable behaviour, not the invariant.
critical_code_review_comments: pitchSim.js (625 lines) is the new authoritative source of truth. Goal detection at lines 253-282 correctly rebuilds state after each goal via resetKickoff. Determinism achieved via mulberry32 + fixed dt.
matchEngine.simulateMatch now runs pitchSim headlessly (lines 119-135). Same public shape — tournamentEngine/leagueEngine untouched. Good.

CanvasMatch.tsx rebuilds identical SimState from matchInputs {seed, _homeStrength, _awayStrength, _homePlayers, _awayPlayers} on mount (lines 133-144) — matches the exact createPitchState args used in the headless run. Determinism confirmed empirically.

MatchScreen regulation ticker removed as required — emittedRegEvents fed only by handleCanvasEvent (line 135-143). Score memo derives from these events (line 227-233). ET still uses pre-baked events which is fine per spec.
fastForward in CanvasMatch (line 192-203) drains the sim synchronously then fires onEnd — measured 25-55ms consistently across 6 skips, well under 500ms target.

Bug candidate: pitchSim never emits SHOT (off-target) events in observed runs. Likely a symptom of the save-claim radius (dist<1.85) intercepting the ball before it can cross the goal line off-target. See action items.
Bug candidate: CanvasMatch filler gate `!st.kickoffTimer` (line 252) apparently never resolves — filler lines never render. Confirm pitchSim clears kickoffTimer to 0 after the initial freeze.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-29 rewrote match simulation to be canvas/physics-authoritative. Data-testids: canvas-match, canvas-stage, canvas-home-name, canvas-away-name, canvas-score, canvas-minute (only appears once first event fires — MatchScreen.jsx:270-278), canvas-skip-button, canvas-commentary. CRITICAL invariant: canvas-score at end === scoreboard === match.result.home/away.score — VERIFIED across 6 matches (both 0-0 and 1-0 outcomes). Fastest way to test: seed ucl_draft_save_v1 with tournamentMode=group and Ajax XI, then play matchdays one at a time, polling canvas-score via setInterval(100ms). Skip performance is 25-55ms consistently. THREE behavioural observations that need main-agent fixes: (1) SHOT off-target events never fire — check pitchSim.js:253-314; (2) filler commentary never renders — check kickoffTimer clearing in pitchSim; (3) low event density gives many 0-event matches. Warning: after 5 tests (multiple close+reopen of match modal), the tournament state advances; use fresh reload with tournament=None if you need consistent seed conditions.
rca of the issue: SHOT / filler / low-density issues share the same root: pitchSim's kickoffTimer likely stays truthy longer than expected (kickoff freeze after every goal/reset), and the keeper-claim radius at pitchSim.js:322 (near.dist<1.85) intercepts shots before they can cross the goal line off-target. Combined effect: physics runs ~1800 ticks but emits only 0-2 events. The determinism itself is not the bug — the physics-driven event generation is under-emitting.
